# test/stg — check of the STG grid (legacy)

> English mirror of test/stg/README.md. The Japanese file is the master copy.

[日本語](../README.md)

The STG grid (`f_gridsystem = 1`) is a legacy implementation kept for comparison with the ENC grid; as a
rule it does not support new features (frozen; developer.md §7). This case checks that STG keeps
working in a minimal setup and that it stops explicitly at initialization for settings it does not
support. There is no reference; `Check_stg.py`, `Run.sh` and `Run_MPI.sh` judge the results.

## Setup (generated by make_init.py)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Grid | 40 × 24, Δx = Δy = 10 m. No domain mask |
| Terrain | A slope descending eastward with gradient 0.02. The outermost row of cells is a wall 20 m high |
| Rain, run | 60 mm/h for 30 minutes (constant throughout). [Dynamic wave](../../../docs/en/users_guide/shallow_water.md) (`f_govequation = 0`), dt = 0.5 s |
| Output | Depth H as text and as float32 bil (`f_output_mode = 3`) |

`p_stgmask.txt` is the same setup with a domain mask (`f_masktype = 1`; the 4 × 4 cells in the
north-east corner are left out).

## Checks

- **Conservation of the continuity equation** (`p_stg.txt`): STG does not compute the outermost row of
  cells, and no rain enters there. The water volume of the computed cells (i = 2–39, j = 2–23) at the end
  (H of the bil × Δx²) must agree with the rain that fell on them, P × T × Δx² × 38 × 22 = 2,508 m³,
  within a relative error of 10⁻⁵ (the present value is 1.2 × 10⁻⁸, the size of float32 rounding). It
  also checks that the outer row stays dry, that H is finite and non-negative, and that the water
  collects on the low east side (mean depth of the east column 0.444 m > west column 0.002 m).
- **Stop with a domain mask** (`p_stgmask.txt`): STG decides where to compute from the land cells of the
  sea mask (`fn_sw`) and never reads the domain mask. Since it would compute outside the mask, it must
  stop at initialization when there are cells outside the domain.
- **One MPI process only** (`./Run_MPI.sh N`): STG does not exchange halos between bands, so with two or
  more processes it must stop at initialization (without the stop, water is lost at the band boundaries;
  in this case the volume drops by 24% and 43% with np = 2 and 4). With np = 1, in addition to the two
  checks above, `Log.txt` must be byte-identical to the serial run.

## Running

```
./Run.sh            # serial (pass/fail; about 1 second)
./Run_MPI.sh 1      # one MPI process (with 2 or more it checks that the run stops)
```

Limitation: this case only checks the conservation of the continuity equation and the stops. The
accuracy of the STG momentum equations (advection, friction) is not checked.
